slices.OBJECTIVE: GitHub Issue authority transport: typed Issue read + raw precondition capture + typed Issue body mutate + verify readback (authority plane)
slices.OUTPUT: Typed GitHub Issue authority methods: readRawAuthority(target)->(revision,digest,body); mutateIssueBody(request)->PortablePlanMutationResponse (at-most-one); verify(target)->(revision,digest,body); error projection for not-found/stale/auth/timeout/unknown
NEGATIVE_CONSTRAINTS: no subject revision as GitHub CAS
slices.ACCEPTANCE: Read-before-write + stale fail closed + single typed mutate + verify-after-write observation handoff; Core import of github.py forbidden

slices.OBJECTIVE: Control-comment projection transport: bounded list + deterministic role resolution (0/1/>1) + update-in-place + verify readback per role

NEGATIVE_CONSTRAINTS: no generic control-comment update that creates missing role
